text_en: Paul, called to be an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God, and our brother Sosthenes,
text_cn: 因天主的旨意，蒙召为耶稣基督宗徒的保禄和索斯特乃弟兄，

text_en: To the church of God that is in Corinth, to those who are sanctified in Christ Jesus, called to be saints, together with all those who in every place call on the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, both their Lord and ours:
text_cn: 致书给格林多的天主教会，就是给那些在基督耶稣内受祝圣，与一切在各地呼求我们的主，亦即他们和我们的主耶稣基督之名，一同蒙召为圣的人。

text_en: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
text_cn: 愿恩宠与平安，由我们的父天主和主耶稣基督赐给你们。

text_en: I give thanks to my God always for you because of the grace of God that has been given you in Christ Jesus,
text_cn: 我时时为你们，对天主在基督耶稣内所赐与你们的恩宠，而感谢我的天主，

text_en: for in every way you have been enriched in him, in speech and knowledge of every kind—
text_cn: 因为藉着他，你们在一切事上，在一切言论和知识上，都成了富有的；

text_en: just as the testimony of Christ has been strengthened among you—
text_cn: 并且我为基督所作的证言，在你们中是这样的坚定，

text_en: so that you are not lacking in any spiritual gift as you wait for the revealing of our Lord Jesus Christ.
text_cn: 以致你们已不缺少任何恩宠，只待我们的主耶稣基督的出现；

text_en: He will also strengthen you to the end, so that you may be blameless on the day of our Lord Jesus Christ.
text_cn: 天主必要坚固你们到底，使你们在我们的主耶稣基督的日子上，无瑕可指。

text_en: God is faithful; by him you were called into the fellowship of his Son, Jesus Christ our Lord.
text_cn: 天主是忠信的，因为你们原是由他所召，为同他的圣子，我们的主耶稣基督，合而为一。

text_en: Now I appeal to you, brothers and sisters, by the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that all of you be in agreement and that there be no divisions among you, but that you be united in the same mind and the same purpose.
text_cn: 弟兄们，我因我们的主耶稣基督之名，求你们众人言谈一致，在你们中不要有分裂，但要同心合意，全然相合。

text_en: For it has been reported to me by Chloe’s people that there are quarrels among you, my brothers and sisters.
text_cn: 因为，我的弟兄们，我由黑罗厄的家人听说你们中发生了纷争。

text_en: What I mean is that each of you says, “I belong to Paul, ” or “I belong to Apollos, ” or “I belong to Cephas, ” or “I belong to Christ. ”
text_cn: 我的意思是说，你们各自声称：我是属保禄的，我是属阿颇罗的，我是属刻法的，我是属基督的。

text_en: Has Christ been divided? Was Paul crucified for you? Or were you baptized in the name of Paul?
text_cn: 基督被分裂了吗？难道保禄为你们被钉死在十字架上吗？ 或者你们受洗是归于保禄名下吗？

text_en: I thank God that I baptized none of you except Crispus and Gaius,
text_cn: 我感谢天主，除了克黎斯颇和加约外，我没有给你们中的任何人付过洗，

text_en: so that no one can say that you were baptized in my name.
text_cn: 免得有人说：你们受洗是归于我的名下。

text_en: (I did baptize also the household of Stephanas; beyond that, I do not know whether I baptized anyone else. )
text_cn: 我还给斯特法纳一家付过洗；此外我就不记得还给谁付过洗了。

text_en: For Christ did not send me to baptize but to proclaim the gospel, and not with eloquent wisdom, so that the cross of Christ might not be emptied of its power.
text_cn: 原来基督派遣我，不是为施洗，而是为宣传福音，且不用巧妙的言辞，免得基督的十字架失去效力。

text_en: For the message about the cross is foolishness to those who are perishing, but to us who are being saved it is the power of God.
text_cn: 原来十字架的道理，为丧亡的人是愚妄，为我们得救的人，却是天主的德能，

text_en: For it is written, “I will destroy the wisdom of the wise, and the discernment of the discerning I will thwart. ”
text_cn: 因为经上记载：“我要摧毁智者的智慧，废除贤者的聪明。”

text_en: Where is the one who is wise? Where is the scribe? Where is the debater of this age? Has not God made foolish the wisdom of the world?
text_cn: 智者在哪里？经师在哪里？这世代的诡辩者又在哪里？天主岂不是使这世上的智慧变成了愚妄吗？

text_en: For since, in the wisdom of God, the world did not know God through wisdom, God decided, through the foolishness of our proclamation, to save those who believe.
text_cn: 因为世人没有凭自己的智慧，认识天主，天主遂以自己的智慧，决意以愚妄的道理来拯救那些相信的人。

text_en: For Jews demand signs and Greeks desire wisdom,
text_cn: 的确，犹太人要求的是神迹，希腊人寻求的是智慧，

text_en: but we proclaim Christ crucified, a stumbling block to Jews and foolishness to Gentiles,
text_cn: 而我们所宣讲的，却是被钉在十字架上的基督：这为犹太人固然是绊脚石，为外邦人是愚妄，

text_en: but to those who are the called, both Jews and Greeks, Christ the power of God and the wisdom of God.
text_cn: 但为那些蒙召的，不拘是犹太人或希腊人，基督却是天主的德能和天主的智慧：

text_en: For God’s foolishness is wiser than human wisdom, and God’s weakness is stronger than human strength.
text_cn: 因为天主的愚妄总比人明智，天主的懦弱也总比人坚强。

text_en: Consider your own call, brothers and sisters: not many of you were wise by human standards, not many were powerful, not many were of noble birth.
text_cn: 弟兄们！你们看看你们是怎样蒙召的：按肉眼来看，你们中有智慧的人并不多，有权势的人也不多，显贵的人也不多；

text_en: But God chose what is foolish in the world to shame the wise; God chose what is weak in the world to shame the strong;
text_cn: 天主偏召选了世上愚妄的，为羞辱那有智慧的；召选了世上懦弱的，为羞辱那坚强的；

text_en: God chose what is low and despised in the world, things that are not, to reduce to nothing things that are,
text_cn: 甚而天主召选了世上卑贱的和受人轻视的，以及那些一无所有的，为消灭那些有的，

text_en: so that no one might boast in the presence of God.
text_cn: 为使一切有血肉的人，在天主前无所夸耀。

text_en: He is the source of your life in Christ Jesus, who became for us wisdom from God, and righteousness and sanctification and redemption,
text_cn: 你们得以结合于基督耶稣内，全是由于天主，也是由于天主，基督成了我们的智慧、正义、圣化者和救赎者，

text_en: in order that, as it is written, “Let the one who boasts, boast in the Lord. ”
text_cn: 正如经上所记载的：“凡要夸耀的，应因主而夸耀。”
